page.title: Hollow Pines
page.desc: Hollow Pines is a cozy browser game about tending a forest cabin through four seasons, with a radio, a sky and visiting animals.
page.intro: Hollow Pines is a cozy browser game about tending a forest cabin through four seasons, with a radio, a sky and visiting animals.

children.title: Hollow Pines Weather Sky
children.desc: Procedural sky, fog and snowfall tuned to a draw budget so laptops stay cool.

children.title: Hollow Pines Visitors
children.desc: Animal visitors with routines, memories and a tiny journal of encounters.

children.title: Hollow Pines Radio
children.desc: In-game radio with licensed-free station scripts and a local MP3 drawer.

children.title: Hollow Pines Save System
children.desc: Protected saves, export bundles and migration checks between versions.

children.title: Hollow Pines Public Demo
children.desc: Browser demo at a custom domain with postcards players can share.

children.title: Hollow Pines Performance
children.desc: Frame-time diagnostics, draw caches and the distinct GPU timeout evidence.

children.title: Hollow Pines Community
children.desc: Discord community with a relay bot that posts visitor journal entries.

synapses.text: an earlier draft treated the radio station as complete; later turns supersede that, and the current state is a tested candidate awaiting the owner's go-ahead.
radio station changes are reviewed before merge; a passing check between versions is bounded evidence, not proof that the migration check works for every user.
an earlier draft treated the visitor routine as complete; later turns supersede that, and the current state is a tested candidate awaiting the owner's go-ahead.
Sam chose to keep the snowfall layer and the radio station distinct so neither substitutes for the other. The decision was recorded with the session that produced it.
the snowfall layer suppresses on laptops, but this does not establish journal entry acceptance or a new release. Review notes remain separate from the shipped build.

synapses.lead: Snowfall layer with a visible gate
synapses.text: the visitor routine is derived from the snowfall layer between versions; exports include it, imports tolerate its absence and nothing is deleted on the way through.
the radio station caps between versions and surfaces a plain warning when the postcard is missing. Manual confirmation is still required.
